stem: A single source-water EC reading is far above the recent trend, while plant and root-zone observations have not changed. What is the strongest immediate response?
choices: Rewrite the nutrient program from the single EC result because a large deviation is sufficient evidence of a source change
Increase irrigation duration across the crop to dilute the source-water EC before repeating the measurement
Treat the crop as temporarily more salt tolerant because unchanged plant appearance confirms the reading is harmless
Repeat the EC measurement with a verified method and compare it with recent source records before changing management
rationale: An isolated abnormal reading should be verified before driving a management change. Trend comparison and measurement confirmation help distinguish a real source-water change from a measurement problem.
